reason: Heading marker length generates the fixed-font heading level.
Server markdown rendering emits Unicode math text/TeX toggle markup.
Unicode script rendering emits source wrappers and interpolated sup/sub classes.
Shared SGR renderer emits named palette colors and active text decorations.
Server markdown media renderer emits media links, toggles and preview placeholders.
Shared path linkifier emits clickable file anchors into generated output.
The server highlighter calls Shiki codeToHtml, which emits the pre.shiki shell and span.line wrappers.
Server diff rendering emits line-kind classes, prefix spans and word-change wrappers.
Fixed-font renderer builds HTML strings, including per-line classes, table markup and path anchors, then inserts that markup; these are not React elements.
The streaming markdown owner creates per-block HTML wrappers imperatively around emitted markdown; these wrappers and descendants share generated typography.
One SVG markup string is inserted by the plain-DOM code-fence toggle and the React glyph host; generated.css owns the shared SVG geometry.
Server calls KaTeX renderToString; KaTeX emits inline/display and error wrappers.
Server markdown preview emits line-target boundaries and rendered chunk wrappers.
